    <script>
      (function () {
        var institucionalHosts = ['hospitalsiriolibanes.org.br', 'hsl-institucional.ddev.site'];
        var host = window.location.hostname;
        var isInstitucional = institucionalHosts.some(function (item) {
          return host === item || host.endsWith('.' + item);
        });
        var isFront = window.location.pathname === '/' || window.location.pathname === '';

        if (!isInstitucional || !isFront) {
          return;
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
          var selectors = [
            '.hsl-image-carousel picture > img.coh-image',
            '#block-hsl-institucional-content article picture > img.coh-image',
            'img.coh-image[data-src]'
          ];

          var img = null;
          for (var index = 0; index < selectors.length; index += 1) {
            img = document.querySelector(selectors[index]);
            if (img) {
              break;
            }
          }

          if (!img) {
            return;
          }

          img.setAttribute('fetchpriority', 'high');
          img.setAttribute('loading', 'eager');

          var imageUrl = img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('src');
          if (imageUrl) {
            img.setAttribute('src', imageUrl);

            var preload = document.createElement('link');
            preload.rel = 'preload';
            preload.as = 'image';
            preload.href = imageUrl;
            preload.setAttribute('fetchpriority', 'high');
            document.head.appendChild(preload);
          }

          var picture = img.closest('picture');
          if (picture) {
            picture.querySelectorAll('source[data-srcset]').forEach(function (source) {
              source.setAttribute('srcset', source.getAttribute('data-srcset'));
            });
          }
        }, { once: true });
      })();
    </script>
